body.x: Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon participated inthe world's largest technology exhibition CES 2020 in Las Vegas, USA,demonstrating Seoul’s Digital Citizen Mayor Office to show how Seoul is usingsmart technology to improve the city's major decision-making efficiency.

Digital Citizen Mayor Office is a smartcity platform that can help monitor all current situations in Seoul in realtime. It is considered as the pinnacle of innovation in Seoul when the mayor and delegationfrom all over the world visits the city hall.
Seoul City installed six 55-inch screens atCES 2020 to embody the Digital Citizen Mayor Office, which is the same size(3.63m wide x 1.67m wide) as the actual mayor's office in Seoul City Hall.

With the theme of Smart City & SmartLife, Seoul Pavilion was set up with a size of 290㎡ (88pyeong) in Eureka Park Tech West, the startup exhibition hall in CES. EurekaPark is an exhibition hall that attracts the attention of many visitors alongwith the Global Enterprise Hall during CES period as it gives a glimpse ofinnovative ideas and technologies of innovative companies.
Below is the full script of the interviewwith Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon. (Note: We interviewed with other broadcasters.)
Q: How did you like your presentationtoday?

A: First of all, the digital mayor officein Seoul is a system in which many technologies of the Industry 4.0, big data,IoT, AI and others that were sporadically developing are appliedcomprehensively in Seoul City, integrating them into one, and coordinating themas a whole. This has never been done in any other city, so I think that's whymany people are interested.
Q: Actually, many foreigners came to themayor office and were surprised. Even today, I saw some foreigners and theywere quite surprised.

A: That's right. When we come to CES, thetechnology in each field is really developing and we think that if it is moreintegrated or combined in the city, the quality of life of citizens will becomemuch higher and the fate of the city will change.
Q: Here at CES, most are to be done… Stillunder development... But the digital mayor office in Seoul has already beendeveloped, and it seems like a very advanced policy. How do you feel?

A: Seoul digital mayor office was developedthree years ago and the heads of the country have already visited our officeand learned a lot. This is also continuously being upgraded, so I am positivethat this will become one of the significant example of the smart city that isbeing talked about globally.
Q: You brought the mayor office in CES…

A: You’ll probably see many companies likebig companies or startups in CES, but not many administrative offices. However,since Seoul City is exhibiting its digital mayor office in CES, I am thinkingthat there will be many smart cities exhibiting... Also, I think Seoul shouldtake the leading place, at least in the smart city area.
Q: Thank you for talking about smart city.Please tell us why startups around the world should pay attention to Seoul.

A: Because Seoul is at the top. First ofall, 5G-based infrastructure and the most advanced IT infrastructure, and freeWi-Fi everywhere. You have Wi-Fi even in the running trains. The subway inSeoul is one of the top 10 miracles that CNN reported. We have thisinfrastructure, and we have been running many testbeds.

So maybe, for example, the card system intransportation. You can take subway, bus, then taxi with just one card. Allthis is possible. This is not seen anywhere else. Therefore, it is impossibleto build a new future city and smart city without referring to Seoul becauseSeoul is the city that has such things ahead of time.
